never: follow up a register row with no consent recorded at sign-in
fill a missing name, mobile or email from anywhere but the register
send a follow-up or a vendor report a person has not approved
message anyone who asked to stop, at any later open or listing
answer an offer or a complaint
write a sentiment, a score or a percentage the replies do not give
put an attendee's name, mobile or email in a vendor report
call anyone who did not ask for a call, or call at all while the call is off
stays_with_person: approving each follow-up before it sends
approving the vendor report before it goes
passing an offer to the vendor
any reply the build could not classify

provider_block.job: every open-home attendee followed up, and the vendor told what buyers actually said

with_us.note: The optional call is Office Voice's governed single call: create_call, basis they_asked, only to an attendee who asked to be called, and off unless the agent turns it on. The consent and unsubscribe record at volume, and a record of who said what that survives a vendor dispute, are not a product and are quoted as a scoped build.

checks.title: The register is read as written, never repaired
The same person at two opens is one attendee
Each draft thanks them and asks one question
A person approves every follow-up before it sends
An opt-out is honoured across every open and listing
Every reply is classified, and an unclear one goes to a person
An offer or a complaint goes to the agent, unanswered
The vendor report counts, quotes and invents nothing
The agent approves the vendor report before it goes
Who said what is on the record
The call is off by default, and only to someone who asked

next.with_us: The optional call is Office Voice's governed single call: create_call, basis they_asked, only to an attendee who asked to be called, and off unless the agent turns it on. The consent and unsubscribe record at volume, and a record of who said what that survives a vendor dispute, are not a product and are quoted as a scoped build. Queue each call with create_call on the Office Voice MCP (office_voice.create_call): the owner mints the key at office-voice.com/app/keys and ticks "Allow this to queue calls", and the dispatcher does the Do Not Call Register check, the calling hours and the one-attempt-a-day limit. There is no production run of these checks yet, so the stub run is the finished build. Do not stand up telephony of your own.
